AIIMS CRE Result 2026 OUT

After successful completion of AIIMS CRE exam, candidates were eagerly waiting for announcement of their results. So this is to inform them that the AIIMS CRE Results have been declared on 11th August 2026 at the official website aiimsexams.ac.in. The All India Institute of Medical Sciences Common Recruitment Examination 2026 is a national-level recruitment test conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi. Exam is held to select eligible candidates for various Junior Engineer, Group B and Group C non-faculty/non-teaching positions across different AIIMS branches and participating central institutes.

As the scorecards have been issued, candidates can now check and download the same by simply visiting the official AIIMS, Delhi website and logging in using their respective candidate ID and password as login credentials. How to Check AIIMS CRE Scorecard 2026 at aiimsexams.ac.in?

All those candidates who appeared for 2026 AIIMS CRE 5 recruitment examination can access their online scorecards by visiting official website and following detailed step-by-step process shared below:

Step 1: Visit official website of All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, i.e., aiimsexams.ac.in

Step 2: Click on latest updated tab.

Step 3: Now search for “AIIMS CRE Result 2026 PDF” download link.

Step 4: Page with redirected to the login window.

Step 5: Carefully enter your respective application number, password/date of birth and security pin.

Step 6: Once the details are filled successfully, click on ‘submit’ option.

Step 7: Check all the details mentioned on the CRE score cards.

Step 8: At the end, make sure you download and save your respective AIIMS CRE Result 2026 PDF for future use.

What details are mentioned on the AIIMS CRE Result 2026?

The online AIIMS CRE 5 result will have all important information, including the scored marks, pass/fail status and much more. Some of the details mentioned on the online scorecards have also been discussed here.

  • Candidate’s Name
  • Roll Number
  • Application Number
  • Date of Birth
  • Category
  • Guardian’s Name
  • Subjects applied for
  • Total marks
  • Percentage
  • AIIMS CRE Cut-Off
  • Pass/Fail Status
  • Details Regarding the next stage
  • Stamp and Signature of AIIMS, Delhi

What’s Next After AIIMS CRE Merit List 2026

After the announcement of the AIIMS CRE Result 2026, candidates are advised to start preparing for the next stage i.e., skill test, document verification and completion of other post-specific formalities. For this stage candidates must keep their original educational, category, age, experience, NOC and other required certificates ready. After successful verification and fulfilment of eligibility conditions, AIIMS/institutes proceed with final selection, appointment/offer letter, and joining formalities. All those candidates who have successfully cleared the examination are advised to keep a close eye on the official AIIMS website for the most latest updates.

AIIMS CRE Result 2026: FAQs

Q1. When will AIIMS CRE Result 2026 announced?

Answer: Official AIIMS CRE merit list has been issued on 11th August 2026.

Q2. Where is AIIMS CRE Result 2026 download link activated?

Answer: AIIMS CRE Merit List links for both Group B and Group C has been activated at AIIMS, New Delhi’s website.

Q3. Will I require any login credentials to access AIIMS CRE Merit List?

Answer: No login credentials are required to access official AIIMS CRE Merit List PDF.
